title: Digital Marketing for Beginners in Nigeria: 9 Proven and Powerful Steps to Build Your Skills and Earn in 2026 -

facts.fact: Seyi, the article's example Nigerian beginner, received one job offer after eleven rejections, at ₦65,000 per month for a Lagos office role that required ₦22,000 monthly in transport costs.
facts.quote: He received eleven rejections and one offer — ₦65,000 per month in a Lagos office requiring ₦22,000 monthly in transport costs.

facts.fact: The article's example beginner, Seyi, had his first digital marketing client paying him ₦60,000 per month, around month eight of his SEO learning.
facts.quote: By month eight, he had his first client — a Lagos restaurant paying him ₦60,000 per month.

facts.fact: The article reports that the example beginner, Seyi, now earns ₦180,000 monthly from three clients.
facts.quote: Today he earns ₦180,000 monthly from three clients, working entirely from Abeokuta.

facts.fact: The article says Seyi began in 2024 by spending three months learning SEO through YouTube tutorials and free Google courses.
facts.quote: In 2024, he decided to spend three months learning SEO through YouTube tutorials and free Google courses.
